product_one_liner.value: Funnel is a marketing intelligence platform that helps marketing and data teams collect and prepare marketing data, build reports, measure performance and optimize budgets.

employee_band.notes: Funnel reports more than 300 employees; its company profile lists 387.

eng_blog.notes: Examples include “Why Funnel Built Its Own Data Ingestion Platform” by CTO Jonas Björk and “Building Funnel’s Declarative Connector Platform” by developer Filips Nastins.

public_docs.notes: Funnel maintains a public knowledge base containing multiple product guides and FAQs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled “Product Engineer - AI Product Experience” and includes an application option.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or model provider was identified in the reviewed product documentation, AI FAQ, technical blog, privacy/security pages or DPA subprocessor section. AWS is identified as infrastructure, not as the underlying model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Funnel claims SOC 2 Type II attestation, ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR compliance is not itself a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 28, 2026: an $80 million debt facility from HSBC Innovation Banking and Hercules Capital, rather than an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 28, 2026 announcement of an $80 million debt facility falls within the window; this was debt financing, not an equity raise.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The reviewed job list contains Product Engineer - AI Product Experience and Measurement Consultant - Boston, but no qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel launched Digital Measurement on May 26, 2026, combining marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution and ad-platform signals.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jonas Björk’s profile dates the end of his Funnel CTO tenure to June 2026 and the start of his subsequent Lovable role to the same month.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Revenue Operations interview explicitly identifies HubSpot as Funnel’s CRM and Gong as a tool its commercial teams use.
